notes: TBox rule edit, tarantula pattern: a well-known member's class membership and its stored value are separate background facts; each world gives up one per member. The rule is scoped to British laymen (KnightBachelor and BritishLayman); the prompts say the new members are British laymen (given) and the well-known members' layman status is firm, so only the knighthood gives way.
